## Queue View

The ticket queue an agent works from.

```gts
<QueueView @tickets={{this.tickets}} @context={{@context}} />
```

- **The counts are the filter.** Six lens counts (in progress, at risk, breached, unassigned, waiting, resolved) sit above the list, and each one, clicked, shows exactly the set it counts. The lenses come from `utils/queue-lens`, shared with Work Rail.
- **Dense rows.** Each row carries eight fields at a readable size.
- **Three empty states.** No tickets at all, nothing matching the filter, and a cleared queue each say something different, because each needs a different next step.

Pass `lens` and `onLens` when something outside owns the lens, such as Work Rail; the built-in count strip then steps aside so the counts don't show twice. `onSelect` makes rows select rather than open. `context` enables the bulk actions, which run real commands.

The linked example shows the list on its own, then driven by a Work Rail.
